newsitem.title: USA: Orphan files Sucraid new drug applicaton.
newsitem.headline: Orphan files Sucraid new drug applicaton.

text.p: Orphan Medical Inc said it has filed a new drug application with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for its Sucraid oral solution.
In a release dated May 7, Orphan said Sucraid ia an enzyme replacement therapy for treatment of congenital sucrase-isomaltase deficiency.

Sucrase is an enzyme produced in the small intestine which is necessary for the digestion of table sugar (sucrose). The primary symptoms of the disease include diarrhea, chronic malabsorption and failure to thrive in infants and toddlers, as well as severe cramping and bloating after eating foods containing sucrose.
Orphan said the only current treatment of the disease is a sucrose-free diet.
